business_summary: AvenuesAI Limited, a payment infrastructure company, provides digital payments and lending solutions for merchants, enterprises, corporations, governments, and financial institutions in India, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company offers CCAvenue, a payment gateway that enables merchants to accept payments through websites and mobile devices; BillAvenue, a unified and interoperable bill-payment layer for utility and recurring payments; ResAvenue, an integrated digital hospitality platform; and Go Payments, which enables customers to access digital services through nearby physical touchpoints. It also provides B2Biz Payments, which automates business collections and payouts through unified workflows; Invoice Payments, which enables merchants to create and share itemized invoices, and collect online payments; TapPay / POS, which extends omnichannel acceptance into offline commerce; Subscriptions, which creates automated recurring-payment plans with configurable billing cycles, payment modes, and event notifications for subscription businesses; CCAvenue TokenPay, which provides network-token based card-on-file capability for compliant card storage and processing; CommerceAI + Risk Intelligence, which enables AI agents and enterprise systems to initiate and orchestrate payment workflows; PayCentral.ai, an agentic payment infrastructure layer; and CCAvenue Neo Banking, which provides digital banking for corporates and SMEs, as well as SNIP and a mobile app. In addition, the company offers AI-powered consumer and merchant platforms under Rediff. Further, it engages in the provision of payment infrastructure, including CPGS towards banks, as well as credit and lending-related services. The company was formerly known as Infibeam Avenues Limited and changed its name to AvenuesAI Limited in January 2026. AvenuesAI Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Gandhinagar, India.
